p.p1 {margin: 0.0px 0.0px 0.0px 0.0px; font: 13.0px 'Helvetica Neue'}Furnished 2-Bedroom Corner Condo in Prime South Granville – 902-1616 W 13th Avenue, Vancouver  Welcome to this beautifully furnished 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner residence in the highly desirable South Granville neighbourhood of Vancouver. Offering a spacious and functional layout, abundant natural light, and an unbeatable location, this home is ideal for professionals looking for comfort and convenience in the heart of the city. This bright corner unit features wraparound, wall-to-wall windows that fill the home with natural light while providing a peaceful and serene outlook. The generous living and dining areas offer plenty of space for relaxing, working from home, or entertaining. The stylish custom kitchen features quartz countertops, a large kitchen island, updated appliances, ample cabinetry, and excellent storage space. The spacious primary bedroom includes a private ensuite bathroom and walk-in closet. A well-sized second bedroom and additional full bathroom provide flexibility for a couple, small family, guests, or a dedicated home office. Step outside to the large covered balcony, a wonderful outdoor space that can be enjoyed throughout much of the year. Don’t miss this opportunity! Contact us today to schedule a private viewing.
